summary: Read the ND Tourism listing (headless; no county page exists, Facebook is login-walled): 15 campsites with water and electric hookups, showers, boat ramp and dock, seasonal, tagged 'Lakefront', phone 701-830-0110. Count 15, water, showers and season (seasonal) written (reported); note corrected (the lake is ~15 mi EAST of Ashley, not 9 mi SW) and cleaned of the hookup/count repeat. Stored lakeview checked hard on imagery: stands (lead below). Mostly-seasonal question flagged. No rate published.
flags: WATERFRONT (contrary claim, judged; lakeview stands): ND Tourism tags the listing 'Lakefront'. Imagery: the campground is a block on the east shore, centre ~46.0112,-99.0667. Its north row (~12 trailers parked nose-to-tail, ~46.01185,-99.0669 to -99.0662) faces an open lawn; the westmost 3-5 units (~46.01185,-99.0669..-99.0667) sit ~10-25 m from the water over open grass and beach, while the rest of the row is 40-55 m back with the boat-ramp road, docks and lawn (day use) in front. The west side is under a continuous shoreline tree band; the east and south units are 100 m+ from the water behind trees. No site map or site numbers exist and nothing says whether the west-end units are sold by the night; they look like long-parked seasonal trailers. An upgrade needs named nightly sites, so lakeview stands; lakefront lead for those west-end units if the park confirms they are nightly.

LONG-STAY (question): imagery shows ~25 trailers packed tightly in rows (seasonal look) against the 15 campsites ND Tourism states; no rate is published anywhere, the operator's only page is a login-walled Facebook page, and Google has no rating. Nothing official states nightly rentals. Reviewer: mostly-seasonal candidate; a phone check (701-830-0110) would settle the nightly share.

OWNERSHIP: stored 'local' (note said McIntosh County park). No county page exists (mcintoshcountynd.com parked; mcintoshnd.com silent, earlier verifier); ND Tourism names no operator; not on the HHS licensed list. Operator unconfirmed.
